1.english_reference: To the chief Musician , A Psalm of David .

traditions.WLC: לַ מְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְ דָוִֽד
traditions.LXX: Εἰς τὸ τέλος · ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυείδ
traditions.VUL: In finem . Psalmus David .

2.english_reference: To the chief Musician , A Psalm of David .

traditions.KJV: To the chief Musician , A Psalm of David .

2.english_reference: The king shall joy in thy strength , O LORD ;

traditions.WLC: יְֽהוָ֗ה בְּ עָזְּ ךָ֥ יִשְׂמַח מֶ֑לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: Κύριε , ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου εὐφρανθήσεται ὁ βασιλεύς ,
traditions.VUL: Dómine in virtúte tua lætábitur rex :
traditions.KJV: The king shall joy in thy strength , O LORD ;

2.english_reference: and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice !

traditions.WLC: וּ֝ בִ ישׁ֥וּעָתְ ךָ֗ מַה יגיל מְאֹֽד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ σωτηρίῳ σου ἀγαλλιάσεται σφόδρα .
traditions.VUL: et super salutáre tuum exsultábit veheménter .
traditions.KJV: and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice !

3.english_reference: Thou hast given him his heart ’s desire

traditions.WLC: תַּאֲוַ֣ת לִ֭בּ וֹ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: τὴν ἐπιθυμίαν τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ ἔδωκας αὐτῷ ,
traditions.VUL: Desidérium cordis eius tribuísti ei :
traditions.KJV: Thou hast given him his heart ’s desire ,

3.english_reference: and hast not withholden the request of his lips

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲרֶ֥שֶׁת שְׂ֝פָתָ֗י ו בַּל מָנַ֥עְתָּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὴν δέησιν τῶν χειλέων αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐστέρησας αὐτόν .
traditions.VUL: et voluntáte labiórum eius non fraudásti eum .
traditions.KJV: and hast not withholden the request of his lips .

traditions.WLC: סֶּֽלָה
traditions.LXX: διάψαλμα .
traditions.KJV: Selah .

4.english_reference: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי תְ֭קַדְּמֶ נּוּ בִּרְכ֣וֹת ט֑וֹב
traditions.LXX: ὅτι προέφθασας αὐτὸν ἐν εὐλογίαις χρηστότητος ,
traditions.VUL: Quóniam prævenísti eum in benedictiónibus dulcédinis :
traditions.KJV: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness :

4.english_reference: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head

traditions.WLC: תָּשִׁ֥ית לְ֝ רֹאשׁ֗ וֹ עֲטֶ֣רֶת פָּֽז
traditions.LXX: ἔθηκας ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ στέφανον ἐκ λίθου τιμίου .
traditions.VUL: posuísti in cápite eius corónam de lápide pretióso .
traditions.KJV: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head .

5.english_reference: He asked life of thee, thou gavest it him

traditions.WLC: חַיִּ֤ים שָׁאַ֣ל מִ֭מְּ ךָ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ζωὴν ᾐτήσατό σε , καὶ ἔδωκας αὐτῷ ,
traditions.VUL: Vitam pétiit a te : et tribuísti ei
traditions.KJV: He asked life of thee , [ and ] thou gavest [ it ] him , [ even ]

5.english_reference: length of days for ever and ever

traditions.WLC: אֹ֥רֶךְ יָ֝מִ֗ים עוֹלָ֥ם וָ עֶֽד
traditions.LXX: μακρότητα ἡμερῶν εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος .
traditions.VUL: longitúdinem diérum in sǽculum , et in sǽculum sǽculi .
traditions.KJV: length of days for ever and ever .

6.english_reference: His glory is great in thy salvation

traditions.WLC: גָּד֣וֹל כְּ֭בוֹד וֹ בִּ ישׁוּעָתֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: μεγάλη ἡ δόξα αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ σωτηρίῳ σου ,
traditions.VUL: Magna est glória eius in salutári tuo :
traditions.KJV: His glory [ is ] great in thy salvation :

6.english_reference: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him

traditions.WLC: ה֥וֹד וְ֝ הָדָר תְּשַׁוֶּ֥ה עָלָֽי ו
traditions.LXX: δόξαν καὶ μεγαλοπρέπειαν ἐπιθήσεις ἐπ᾽ αὐτόν ·
traditions.VUL: glóriam et magnum decórem impónes super eum .
traditions.KJV: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him .

7.english_reference: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי תְשִׁיתֵ֣ הוּ בְרָכ֣וֹת לָ עַ֑ד
traditions.LXX: ὅτι δώσεις αὐτῷ εὐλογίαν εἰς αἰῶνα αἰῶνος ,
traditions.VUL: Quóniam dabis eum in benedictiónem in sǽculum sǽculi :
traditions.KJV: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever :

7.english_reference: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance

traditions.WLC: תְּחַדֵּ֥ הוּ בְ֝ שִׂמְחָ֗ה אֶת פָּנֶֽי ךָ
traditions.LXX: εὐφρανεῖς αὐτὸν ἐν χαρᾷ μετὰ τοῦ προσώπου σου .
traditions.VUL: lætificábis eum in gáudio cum vultu tuo .
traditions.KJV: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance .

8.english_reference: For the king trusteth in the LORD

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי הַ֭ מֶּלֶךְ בֹּטֵ֣חַ בַּ יהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐλπίζει ἐπὶ Κύριον ,
traditions.VUL: Quóniam rex sperat in Dómino :
traditions.KJV: For the king trusteth in the LORD ,

8.english_reference: and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ חֶ֥סֶד עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן בַּל יִמּֽוֹט
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τῷ ἐλέει τοῦ ὑψίστου οὐ μὴ σαλευθῇ .
traditions.VUL: et in misericórdia Altíssimi non commovébitur .
traditions.KJV: and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved .

9.english_reference: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies

traditions.WLC: תִּמְצָ֣א יָ֭דְ ךָ לְ כָל אֹיְבֶ֑י ךָ
traditions.LXX: εὑρεθείη ἡ χείρ σου πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐχθροῖς σου ,
traditions.VUL: Inveniátur manus tua ómnibus inimícis tuis :
traditions.KJV: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies :

9.english_reference: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee

traditions.WLC: יְ֝מִֽינְ ךָ תִּמְצָ֥א שֹׂנְאֶֽי ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἡ δεξιά σου εὕροι πάντας τοὺς μισοῦντάς σε .
traditions.VUL: déxtera tua invéniat omnes qui te odérunt .
traditions.KJV: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee .

10.english_reference: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger

traditions.WLC: תְּשִׁיתֵ֤ מוֹ כְּ תַנּ֥וּר אֵשׁ֮ לְ עֵ֪ת פָּ֫נֶ֥י ךָ
traditions.LXX: θήσεις αὐτοὺς ὡς κλίβανον πυρὸς εἰς καιρὸν τοῦ προσώπου σου ·
traditions.VUL: Pones eos ut clíbanum ignis in témpore vultus tui :
traditions.KJV: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger :

10.english_reference: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath

traditions.WLC: יְ֭הוָה בְּ אַפּ֣ וֹ יְבַלְּעֵ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: Κύριε , ἐν ὀργῇ σου συνταράξεις αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: Dóminus in ira sua conturbábit eos ,
traditions.KJV: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath ,

10.english_reference: and the fire shall devour them

traditions.WLC: וְֽ תֹאכְלֵ֥ ם אֵֽשׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ καταφάγεται αὐτοὺς πῦρ .
traditions.VUL: et devorábit eos ignis .
traditions.KJV: and the fire shall devour them .

11.english_reference: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth

traditions.WLC: פִּ֭רְיָ מוֹ מֵ אֶ֣רֶץ תְּאַבֵּ֑ד
traditions.LXX: τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῶν ἀπὸ γῆς ἀπολεῖς ,
traditions.VUL: Fructum eórum de terra perdes :
traditions.KJV: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth ,

11.english_reference: and their seed from among the children of men

traditions.WLC: וְ֝ זַרְעָ֗ ם מִ בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτῶν ἀπὸ υἱῶν ἀνθρώπων .
traditions.VUL: et semen eórum a fíliis hóminum .
traditions.KJV: and their seed from among the children of men .

12.english_reference: For they intended evil against thee

traditions.WLC: כִּי נָט֣וּ עָלֶ֣י ךָ רָעָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἔκλιναν εἰς σὲ κακά ,
traditions.VUL: Quóniam declinavérunt in te mala :
traditions.KJV: For they intended evil against thee :

traditions.WLC: חָֽשְׁב֥וּ מְ֝זִמָּ֗ה
traditions.LXX: διελογίσαντο βουλὴν
traditions.VUL: cogitavérunt consília ,
traditions.KJV: they imagined a mischievous device , [ which ]

12.english_reference: [ which ] they are not able [ to perform ]

traditions.WLC: בַּל יוּכָֽלוּ
traditions.LXX: ἣν οὐ μὴ δύνωνται στῆσαι .
traditions.VUL: quæ non potuérunt stabilíre .
traditions.KJV: they are not able [ to perform ] .

13.english_reference: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back

traditions.WLC: כִּ֭י תְּשִׁיתֵ֣ מוֹ שֶׁ֑כֶם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι θήσεις αὐτοὺς νῶτον ,
traditions.VUL: Quóniam pones eos dorsum :
traditions.KJV: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back , [ when ]

13.english_reference: [ when ] thou shalt make ready [ thine arrows ] upon thy strings against the face of them

traditions.WLC: בְּ֝ מֵֽיתָרֶ֗י ךָ תְּכוֹנֵ֥ן עַל פְּנֵי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: ἐν τοῖς περιλοίποις σου ἑτοιμάσεις τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: in relíquiis tuis præparábis vultum eórum .
traditions.KJV: thou shalt make ready [ thine arrows ] upon thy strings against the face of them .

14.english_reference: Be thou exalted , LORD , in thine own strength

traditions.WLC: ר֣וּמָ ה יְהוָ֣ה בְּ עֻזֶּ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ὑψώθητι , Κύριε , ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου ,
traditions.VUL: Exaltáre Dómine in virtúte tua :
traditions.KJV: Be thou exalted , LORD , in thine own strength : [ so ]

14.english_reference: [ so ] will we sing and praise thy power

traditions.WLC: נָשִׁ֥ירָה וּֽ֝ נְזַמְּרָה גְּבוּרָתֶֽ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ᾄσομεν καὶ ψαλοῦμεν τὰς δυναστείας σου .
traditions.VUL: cantábimus et psallémus virtútes tuas .
traditions.KJV: will we sing and praise thy power .
